_about: Pairwise SHOULDER-bladedness comparisons. Built by cornerman-backend/bladedness/build_pair_labeler.py. Pairs are FIXED and seeded so every labeler answers the same comparisons — that is what makes inter-rater agreement computable. Random (non-adaptive) pairing on purpose; adaptive selection inflates the reliability statistic.
